title: Credit-led fintech startup Olyv raises $6M
summary: Credit-led fintech startup Olyv secures 6 million dollars in funding
detailed: Credit-led fintech platform Olyv has raised $6 million (~Rs57 crore) from Nippon Life India AIF Management Limited and existing investors, extending its Series B round to approximately $30 million.

Key operating metrics include nearly 2 million monthly active users, over 50 million app downloads, ~80 lakh loans disbursed, and ~Rs13,000 crore in cumulative transactions across 19,000+ pin codes in India.
Involved parties include CEO Rohit Garg, co-founders Amit Chandel, Vinay Singh, Jayant Upadhyay, and institutional backers like Fundamentum and SMBC Asia Rising Fund.

This matters because Olyv plans to use the capital to scale technology and products to reach a target of 100 million users and over $1 billion in AUM by FY29 while maintaining consecutive quarterly profitability.
sentences: Credit-led fintech platform Olyv has raised $6 million (~Rs57 crore) from Nippon Life India AIF Management Limited (Nippon India Alternative Investments) along with existing investors, extending the total Series B funding round to ~$30 million.
With this investment, Nippon India Alternative Investments joins Olyv’s existing investors including Fundamentum and SMBC Asia Rising Fund.
Founded in 2016 by Rohit Garg, Amit Chandel, Vinay Singh, and Jayant Upadhyay, Olyv offers products across personal loans, gold savings, and credit health management.
The company said in a statement that it has nearly 2 million monthly active users and more than 5 crore app downloads, and serves customers across 19,000+ pin codes in India.
Olyv also said it has disbursed ~80 lakh loans and facilitated ~Rs13,000 crore in cumulative transactions, while consistently increasing PAT profitability for 14 consecutive quarters.
The company is targeting a user base of 100 million and AUM of over $1 billion by By FY29.
